channel.title: WatchGuard incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from WatchGuard's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: 2026-09-04 - AMER - Mexico/Central FireCloud PoP connection issue [resolved]
item.description:
An infrastructure update was deployed in the Mexico/Central PoP to address the client scaling issues detected earlier today. We are no longer experiencing connectivity issues and policy handling issues in this region, and this incident is now resolved.
We will continue to monitor the infrastructure to ensure the environment remains stable for clients.

item.title: 2026-09-03 - AMER - FireCloud PoP issue [resolved]
item.description: We are no longer experiencing connectivity issues affecting the Mexico/Central Point of Presence (PoP), and this incident is now resolved. Service is operating normally at this time. We apologize for any impact this incident may have caused you or your customers and thank you for your patience while our teams worked to restore service.

item.title: 2026-09-01 - AMER - FireCloud PoP issue [resolved]
item.description: On September 1, 2026, at 16:41 UTC, some customers began experiencing connectivity issues due to a problem affecting the Mexico/Central Point of Presence (PoP). Our engineering team worked to restore service, and the PoP returned to normal operation on September 2, 2026, at 11:44 UTC. We apologize for any impact this incident may have caused you or your customers. This issue affected connectivity through the Mexico/Central PoP only.

item.title: 2026-08-11 - Global - Issue with RAI Dashboard statistics [resolved]
item.description:
We are no longer experiencing issues affecting the display of Signals statistics on the WatchGuard Cloud RAI dashboard, and this incident is now resolved.

The recovery process has been completed, all queued data has been processed, and Signals statistics are displaying as expected. Following continued monitoring and validation, our teams have confirmed that normal operations have been fully restored across all production regions.

We apologize for the impact this issue may have caused and thank you for your patience throughout this extended recovery effort.

item.description: Issue has been fully resolved, and all services are operating normally. Signal generation and Attestation processing are operating within expected timeframes. Our team will continue to monitor the environment as part of standard operations. We appreciate your patience and understanding throughout this incident. This incident has been resolved.

item.title: 2026-06-05 - GLOBAL - Issues with New Product Activations and Renewals [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting new product activations and renewals has been resolved. Between 7:30 AM UTC and 8:40 AM UTC, some delays were observed due to a backlog in the processing queue.

The backlog has now been fully cleared, and services within WatchGuard Cloud are operating normally.

Our teams will continue to monitor the system to ensure ongoing stability. Thank you for your patience and understanding while we worked to resolve this issue.
